title: Feature selection protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Feature selection should complete this objective: Compare univariate and model-based selection. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand feature reduction.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Fit selection only on training folds and report whether results are stable.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for SelectKBest, SelectFromModel, Pipeline and does not run the learner code. Fit selection only on training folds and report whether results are stable.
